title: The support of a cone current is invariant under positive dilations (parent step 3, B4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be a cone current (IsConeCurrent C: η_{0,λ#}C = C for every λ > 0). Then t·x ∈ spt C for every t > 0 and every x ∈ spt C. Here spt C = ℝ^P ∖ Z(C), where the zero region Z(C) is the union of all open W ⊆ ℝ^P with compact closure on which C vanishes, i.e. C(ω) = 0 for every test form ω with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ C.support, t • x ∈ C.support
